verdict.rationale: Lago ships AI features (an AI billing agent, a Dunning Agent and an MCP server), so a data-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack does not document any setting, policy or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Self-hosting via Docker is a deployment option, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
